'''Graayson's Company''' was a military unit in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Company/Legends|company]] was part of the [[Ralltiir Corps]], but despite being smaller than the [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]-sized [[Telerath 2nd]] and [[Serroco Colonial]], it reported directly to [[Corps Command]] because of the agreement under which it had entered Republic service.<ref name="KOTOR guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Graayson's Company was mentioned in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2008]] supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', in "Chapter XI: The Republic,"<ref name="KOTOR guide" /> a chapter that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="Miller Campaign">{{Faraway|url=games/swkotorguide.html|text=Star Wars Roleplaying Game: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide}}</ref>
